title: Only the hat
prompt: Make only the hat red.
why: The hat's colour is two small paths; the ears beside it are the same brown, and a black silhouette under the whole figure looks like the hat.

title: The glass of the magnifying glass
prompt: Make the glass of the magnifying glass light blue.
why: The highlight inside the glass is the exact tan of the brow marking, so recolouring by colour repaints the eyebrow.

title: The light stripes on the tail
prompt: Make the light brown stripes on the raccoon's tail grey. Keep the dark stripes as they are.
why: The stripes' browns are nearly the coat's browns.

title: The region with the star
prompt: Colour the region with the star in it dark green.
why: All regions are one colour, and the neighbour's bounding box also covers the star.

title: The Marketing slice
prompt: Make the Marketing slice red.
why: Slices are drawn in an order unrelated to their labels; only the label's position says which slice it is.

title: The cat's ears
prompt: make the inside of the cat's ears purple
why: A stripe on the forehead wears the same orange as the insides of both ears.

title: The coat
prompt: Make the coat dark green.
why: The coat is a dozen paths in slightly different browns. Graded by eye.

title: A colour from the embedded photo
prompt: Make the 'New members welcome' line the same colour as the scarf in the photo.
why: The scarf exists only in the pixels of an embedded JPEG.

title: Describe a drawing with no text
prompt: Add a <title> that tells screen readers what this drawing shows.

title: cat
pencil

why: Nothing in the markup says it is a cat holding a pencil.

title: The shield without its stars
prompt: Remove the stars above the shield; keep only the shield.
why: Every star and the shield are one path, so the stars cannot be deleted as elements.

title: The heart in the doorway
prompt: Take out the heart in the doorway.
why: The house and the heart are one white path; deleting the path removes the house too.

title: The mountains
prompt: Make the mountains slate blue, #3E5C76.
why: The mountains share a path with the shore, which must keep its colour.

title: The birds
prompt: Paint the birds #C0392B.
why: Same scene: the birds are one path among three that are all the same black.

title: The sun and its arc
prompt: Colour the sun and the arc around it gold, #D4A017.
why: Same scene: the sun and its arc share one path, the mountains another.

title: Delete the card, keep the lettering
prompt: Remove the purple card behind the text.
why: The mark and the lettering are near-white, so removing the card alone leaves a picture that looks empty.

title: Trim to the badge
prompt: Trim the canvas down to the badge, leaving a small margin.
why: A small badge sits far inside a large canvas; trimming too tight cuts it off.

title: A new step in a flowchart
prompt: Add a 'Review' step between 'Draft' and 'Publish', with arrows, matching the existing style. Make room for it.
why: Room has to be made: either the canvas grows or every step shrinks, and the labels must stay readable. Graded by eye.

title: Sort a bar chart and label it
prompt: Sort the bars from tallest to shortest (keep each month's label with its bar) and add the value above each bar.
why: Each label must move with its bar, and the values have to be read off the bar heights. Graded by eye.

title: Dark theme for a settings card
prompt: Switch this card to a dark theme.
why: The colours live in style rules, so the edit belongs there, and the toggles should keep their accent. Graded by eye.

title: Flip two toggles
prompt: Turn on Push notifications and turn off Sound.
why: A toggle is two things, the track colour and the knob position, and both have to change.

title: Curve a badge's text
prompt: Make the club name curve along the top of the gold ring instead of being a straight line.
why: Needs a path for the text to follow, sized to the ring. Graded by eye.

title: Give the raccoon a scarf
prompt: Give the raccoon a red knitted scarf around its neck.
why: A drawn addition on traced art: it has to land at the neck and look like a scarf. Graded by eye.

title: Night city to sunset
prompt: Turn this night scene into a sunset: a warm orange-to-purple sky and no stars.
why: The sky, the stars and the moon are anonymous traced paths among the buildings. Graded by eye.

title: A boat in the lighthouse beam
prompt: Add a small fishing boat on the waves, lit by the lighthouse beam.
why: A drawn addition that has to sit on the waves, inside the beam. Graded by eye.

title: Change a line on a poster
prompt: Change 'New members welcome' to 'First visit free' and make it twice as big.
why: Plain text, beside an embedded photo the edit must leave alone.

title: Offers a picture: Draw me a cute kitten
prompt: Draw me a cute kitten
why: The starter sample prompt. A hand-drawn kitten from circles and lines looks amateurish.

title: Offers a picture: Make a logo for a bakery called Crumb
prompt: Make a logo for a bakery called Crumb
why: A logo for the user's own brand is a designed asset.

title: Offers a picture: Create an app icon svg for a meditation app
prompt: Create an app icon svg for a meditation app
why: Saying "svg" names the format, not a request to draw by hand.

title: Offers a picture: Draw me a loose crayon sketch of a bicycle
prompt: Draw me a loose crayon sketch of a bicycle
why: A style with texture and character is what the image model is for.

title: Offers a picture: Design a friendly mascot for a hiking club
prompt: Design a friendly mascot for a hiking club
why: A character, drawn to be seen.

title: Offers a picture: a fox
prompt: a fox
why: A bare subject with no verb still asks for a picture of it.

title: Draws by hand: Draw a flowchart with three steps: Plan, Build, Ship
prompt: Draw a flowchart with three steps: Plan, Build, Ship
why: A diagram is exact boxes, arrows and text.

title: Draws by hand: Draw a red circle in the middle
prompt: Draw a red circle in the middle
why: A plain shape.

title: Draws by hand: Add some random stars
prompt: Add some random stars
why: Simple shapes scattered as decoration.

title: Draws by hand: Make a bar chart for four quarters: 10, 20, 15, 30
prompt: Make a bar chart for four quarters: 10, 20, 15, 30
why: A chart is data, drawn exactly.
